title: Trail Onboarding Answer Envelope
description: Structured-output envelope for the Phase B LLM-driven onboarding Q&A. The local ollama model is asked to fill one field per question; each field carries the model's choice (selected), an optional reasoning note, and the list of ScanReport collector_ids the model drew on as evidence. The Rust `ask_onboarding` consumer validates the response against this schema and then flattens the envelope into the typed `OnboardingAnswers` struct that Phase C (config-writer) consumes.

claude_sessions_paths.description: Which ~/.claude/projects/* directories to monitor. selected=true means the model recommends monitoring; the absolute paths live in notes (one per line) when selected=true, or are omitted when the scan found no claude_sessions evidence.

notes.description: Free-form reasoning. When selected=true, a bullet list of absolute paths; when selected=false, a one-sentence explanation.

evidence_refs.description: ScanReport collector_ids the model drew on (e.g. 'claude_sessions'). Empty when the scan returned no candidates.

github.description: Whether to enable the github collector. selected=true enables it; repos is a comma-separated list under notes when selected=true.

calendar_ics.description: Whether to enable the calendar collector. selected=true enables it; notes may carry the .ics paths when known.

voice.description: Voice capture configuration. selected=true means enable whisper; model+language are enum strings.

model.description: Whisper model size — tiny (fastest, lowest accuracy), base, small (slowest, highest accuracy of the three).

language.description: BCP-47 primary subtag the user speaks. Drives the transcribe language hint.

review_time.description: When the user wants the daily review pushed. cadence is the broad bucket; hour_utc is the specific hour.

cadence.description: Coarse timing bucket. 'morning' = ~08:00 UTC, 'evening' = ~22:00 UTC, 'weekly' = Friday ~22:00 UTC.

summarizer.description: Which backend to use for the day-summary. 'ollama' routes to the local ollama server (requires the bin on $PATH); 'stub' is a no-op for laptops without GPU.

model.description: When backend=ollama, the model name (e.g. 'qwen2.5:7b'); when backend=stub, the literal string 'stub'.

transport.description: How the laptop pushes day-summaries to the VPS. 'tailscale' uses the Tailscale MagicDNS hostname (no key exchange); 'ssh' uses the keychain-stored ed25519 key from item 1-2.

question_log.description: Per-question reasoning trace. One entry per field above; entries are written in the same order as the schema's `required` array so the audit log is stable.

question.description: The question that was asked of the model (verbatim, for auditability).

reasoning.description: One-paragraph free-form reasoning. The model's own words; the auditor reads this when the user later disputes a default.

evidence_refs.description: ScanReport collector_ids the model referenced when answering this question.
